sections.skill: Write plain license terms and manage customer access

questions.prompt: What does a customer usually buy with a digital product?

choices.text: A license to use it under stated terms
Full ownership of the product and its code
The right to resell unlimited copies

questions.correct_answer: A license to use it under stated terms
questions.intro: Digital products are usually sold as a LICENSE: permission to use them under stated terms, not ownership of the product itself. A license states who may use it (one person, a team, a business), how many devices or projects, whether it may be resold or shared, and how long it lasts. Customer ACCESS is often managed by accounts or download links. Write the license in plain words, show it before purchase, and decide what happens to access if a customer cancels or requests a refund.

sections.skill: A movie ticket, not the movie

questions.prompt: A movie ticket gives you what?

choices.text: Permission to watch under certain rules
Full ownership of the whole film and its copies

questions.intro: A movie ticket lets you watch the film in that theater at that time. It does not let you copy the film or sell screenings. A digital license works the same way: the buyer gets permission to use the product in stated ways, not ownership of the product itself. The ticket's rules are printed so everyone knows them.
